description:
A man in a suit thinks differently. 
 
People think this work is about cloth. It is not.   
 
It is about the quarter inch. The pitch of a shoulder, the roll of a lapel – these are not details. These are the pieces that create a whole. 
 
We spend hours on a single seam. Not because the man will notice. Because he will feel it, without ever knowing why. This is a life lived in millimetres. 
 
I am not just shaping a beautiful suit. I am shaping the shoulders that will carry a great life. 
 
I have seen men before the important moments in their lives.  Before the proposal. Before the speech. Before becoming fathers. 
 
And every time, there is a small silence – the moment they look at themselves differently.

description:
In this short film, commissioned by ZEGNA and directed by Zach Tavel, we find Stellan Skarsgård getting ready at Chateau Marmont in Los Angeles on Oscars night. 

 It's a significant evening. Stellan has earned his first Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for Joachim Trier's 'Sentimental Value', making history as the first actor from an international film to be nominated in this category. 

 The stage is set as he wears Su Misura:  a black peak-lapel wool tuxedo with wide-leg trousers and a white poplin-covered button shirt. 

 He moves elegantly through a familiar ritual: adjusting cufflinks, fastening his watch, and spritzing Il Calamaio – a scent from ZEGNA's new fragrance collection, Memorie.  

 Then, for the final touch, he struggles to fasten his black silk bow tie. And here, the film takes a turn. In homage to the great European art cinema tradition, when he calls for assistance, two mimes appear at his door – a nod to Giulietta Masina's iconic physical performance in Federico Fellini's 1954 masterpiece, 'La Strada'. 

 Stellan Skarsgård's signature dry humour and effortless comic timing are only enhanced by his quiet charm and commanding presence.  

The bow tie is forgotten. He is on his way to the Oscars. 

#Oscars2026

description:
In 1963, history was made.

Our Founder established the Ermenegildo Zegna Wool Trophy Awards in Australia – a prestigious prize created to support woolgrowers in their pursuit of the finest wool in the world.

The finest wool fleece is collected, and Vellus Aureum is created.

The name Vellus Aureum was inspired by the mythical tale of the Golden Fleece, represented as a winged ram. It reflects the Founder’s ambition and quest for the extraordinary.

In 2023, the Vellus Aureum world record for the finest single wool fleece was set at 9.4 microns.

Today, our Founder’s quest for the extraordinary lives on.
